unconsidered_routes.title: Expansion grammar with SLM-curated vocabulary (Tracery / Dwarf Fortress / Caves of Qud style)
unconsidered_routes.proposal: Author per-character and per-register grammars (Tracery-like) whose terminals are drawn from model-drafted, human-curated word and phrase banks. Runtime expansion is pure and seeded, so output is deterministic and every sentence is derivable. The SLM works at authoring time to propose terminals and rules, the gate checks them.
unconsidered_routes.reference: Tracery; Caves of Qud's sultan histories and gospel grammars; Dwarf Fortress artifact descriptions
unconsidered_routes.replaces_or_changes: Replaces the notion that variety needs live inference; sits between pools and runtime generation and fits the existing StoryletTemplate slot grammar.

unconsidered_routes.title: Constrained selection instead of free generation (rerank-only runtime model)
unconsidered_routes.proposal: At runtime the model does not write; it scores a pool of N authored/curated candidates against the LineBrief (embedding similarity or log-likelihood) and picks one. This is the only place a MiniLM-class embedder earns its keep, is cacheable and gives deterministic output for a fixed model and seed. It cannot hallucinate facts because it cannot emit new words.
unconsidered_routes.reference: Retrieval-based dialogue systems; Versu / Prom Week style authored-content selection
unconsidered_routes.replaces_or_changes: Gives the already-pinned @huggingface/transformers and MiniLM a P2-compatible job instead of intent parsing.

unconsidered_routes.title: Fact-first generation: the model only paraphrases a structured proposition
unconsidered_routes.proposal: The sim emits a proposition (speaker, act, fact ids, tone, tells). A deterministic realiser produces a plain sentence from it; the model, if used at all, only restyles it under the gate that all fact ids and names survive. Contradiction becomes checkable by string/id match rather than judgement.
unconsidered_routes.reference: NLG pipeline (content determination, then surface realisation); Versu's social-practice generation; Façade's discourse acts
unconsidered_routes.replaces_or_changes: Changes what is passed to the generator from 'a prompt' to a typed LineBrief, and makes the 05f gate cheap.
